subject: Mathematics
name: Basic 4 Mathematics
description: The Basic 4 Mathematics curriculum focuses on developing number sense, algebraic thinking, geometric reasoning, and data handling skills. Learners will explore multi-digit numbers, basic operations, fractions, decimals, patterns, equations, shapes, measurement, and data interpretation.

strands.title: Number
strands.description: Developing number sense and operational skills with whole numbers, fractions, and decimals.
